goal: Prevent block storage I/O failures from being silently swallowed or triggering hard crashes
Ensure nodes shut down gracefully instead of hanging when storage disks become inaccessible
agreement: Broad support for adding tests and improving failure handling (frankomosh, l0rinc, pinheadmz, rkrux, sedited)
Unaddressed objection: ignores errors and causes index regressions under -txindex (maflcko, w0xlt)
Contested objection: returning null instead of throwing loses error context and intent (josibake, maflcko)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it prevents an ungraceful assertion crash during peer block transaction processing
Filesystem I/O failures while serving blocks are an uncommon operational edge case

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents nodes from silently freezing when block storage fails during chain activation
A clean fatal shutdown preserves operator visibility and node integrity during disk failures
